summary: Work through The Architecture of This Book.

blocks.md: This lesson follows **The Architecture of This Book** in *The Causal Boundary* (Vol IV).

blocks.source: Vol IV, The Causal Boundary, § The Architecture of This Book
blocks.md: Moving a learned proposal, such as the running machine's trajectory to open a warehouse cage door, from an abstract task requirement to safe, justified physical operation requires a disciplined four-stage progression. The engineer must first bound what the hardware plant can physically achieve and characterize what the learned proposer has demonstrated under rigorous testing. The engineer must then build an isolated runtime monitor to intercept live proposals and establish the operational conditions under which continued execution remains justified. Each stage corresponds to one of the four laws.

A system is physical AI only when it has a learned statistical model, consequential physical feedback, and delegated authority at once; an independent deterministic veto does not remove delegated authority, while per-command human approval does.
